description: Source code for socket implementation and operations in PyTorch's distributed c10d module, including socket creation, connection, acceptance, and configuration, with platform-specific handling for Windows and Unix-like systems.

classes.name: SocketImpl
classes.description: Implementation of socket operations including creation, configuration, accepting connections, and platform-specific socket handling.

classes.name: SocketListenOp
classes.description: Operation class for setting up a listening socket on specified port and address family.

classes.name: SocketListenFromFdOp
classes.description: Operation class for taking over an existing socket file descriptor and listening on a specified port.

classes.name: SocketConnectOp
classes.description: Operation class for establishing a connection to a specified host and port with retries and timeouts.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes socket subsystem, especially on Windows (WSAStartup).

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Creates a listening socket on a specified port with options.

methods.name: listenFromFd
methods.description: Takes over an existing socket file descriptor and starts listening.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to a host and port with specified options.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts an incoming connection on a listening socket.

methods.name: port
methods.description: Retrieves the port number of the socket.

methods.name: waitForInput
methods.description: Waits for input on the socket with a timeout.

methods.name: repr
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the socket.
